item.title: SEBI issues upcoming IPOs GMP advisory - ‘publication of such pre-listing premium figures may be detrimental’
item.description: SEBI urged intermediaries and market participants to stop publishing grey market premium (GMP) figures for IPOs, warning that these unregulated estimates are unverified and cannot reliably predict listing prices or returns. Investors should avoid GMP-linked transactions and use authorised platforms.

item.title: Asian markets follow Wall Street: Nikkei, Kospi jump up to 8% as Jensen Huang’s return sparks rally in AI stocks
item.description: Asian stocks rose on Tuesday as Nvidia’s 31.5% surge on Wall Street revived confidence in AI-related shares. South Korea’s KOSPI rose 7.5%, Taiwan’s benchmark gained 9.1% and Japan’s Nikkei climbed 4.5%. Investors remain cautious about AI spending, earnings growth and the US interest rate outlook.

item.title: Sebi warns investors against relying on grey market premiums for IPOs

item.description: Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, citing confidence in his leadership and no national security concerns after consulting US officials.
